enabled.description: Set to "1" to enable starting syncache-drb on boot, or "0" to disable it.

port.description: The port number for the default dRuby URI.

ttl.description: The default time-to-live limit for cached objects in seconds.

size.description: The default limit on the number of cached objects.

flushdelay.description: Minimum number of seconds between flush operations. If less time has passed since the last flush, the next one is delayed.
